items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — sets up expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ simulating lb=false and lb=true scenarios; exercises provision tasks
items.notes: Renders default.conf.j2 template under /tmp/molecule_test/ for 5 scenarios: lb disabled, lb+least_conn, lb+hash (no-space comma input), lb+ip_hash, lb+round_robin. Kubernetes resource tasks stubbed with debug+molecule-notest tags since they require a live cluster.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths; validates rendered NGINX config for lb=false and lb=true with each lb_method value
items.notes: 6 plays: (1) stat all 5 config files exist+non-empty, (2) lb-disabled content assertions, (3) least_conn content assertions, (4) hash+$request_uri assertions, (5) ip_hash and round_robin assertions, (6) Kubernetes resource checks stubbed with molecule-notest tags. All loops use prefixed loop_vars and bracket notation.
